prompt: Create an ultra-realistic, cinematic double-exposure romantic portrait of a young South Asian couple at a peaceful rocky beach during golden hour. The composition features a large, intimate close-up of the couple occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame, with their foreheads gently touching, eyes closed, and soft genuine smiles expressing deep affection, trust, and emotional connection. Their noses nearly touch, creating a tender, romantic moment filled with warmth and serenity. Below the close-up, seamlessly blend a second scene where the same couple sits barefoot on dark volcanic rocks beside the ocean, facing one another with loving eye contact. The man sits casually with one knee raised while the woman rests her chin gently on her hand, smiling naturally. Their relaxed body language conveys comfort, companionship, and timeless romance. The man has thick, voluminous wavy black hair with a soft natural texture, light stubble, and wears a loose white linen button-up shirt with sleeves casually rolled and beige relaxed-fit trousers. The woman has long dark hair styled neatly back, wears elegant silver jhumka earrings, subtle natural makeup, a tiny black bindi, and a flowing white embroidered traditional dress with delicate floral textures and intricate lace detailing. The background showcases dramatic monsoon clouds illuminated by soft golden sunset light. Gentle sun rays filter through the clouds, creating cinematic volumetric lighting. Ocean waves crash dramatically against black shoreline rocks, producing sparkling water splashes and sea mist. The horizon glows with warm orange and golden tones while the sky transitions into cool gray-blue storm clouds, creating a striking contrast. Use a realistic double-exposure blending technique so the upper portrait naturally fades into the lower beach landscape without harsh edges. Preserve facial proportions, realistic skin texture, detailed eyelashes, subtle facial hair, embroidered fabric details, and individual hair strands. The color palette should combine warm golden sunset highlights with cool blue-gray coastal tones, creating a dreamy yet natural cinematic atmosphere. Add soft rim lighting around the subjects, gentle depth of field, realistic reflections on wet rocks, subtle ocean haze, and crisp environmental details. The mood should feel peaceful, intimate, nostalgic, and emotionally rich-like a premium romantic movie poster. promptZh: 创作一张超写实、电影质感的双重曝光浪漫肖像，主角为 一对年轻的南亚情侣，地点位于 宁静的礁石海滩，时间设定在黄金时刻。构图上，画面上方三分之二处为情侣的亲密大特写，两人额头轻触，双眼微闭，脸上洋溢着真挚柔和的微笑，传达出深厚的情感、信任与心灵共鸣。鼻尖轻触，营造出温暖而宁静的浪漫瞬间。在特写下方，无缝融合第二个场景：同一对情侣赤脚坐在海边的黑色火山岩上，深情对视。男子随意坐着，单膝抬起，女子手托下巴，自然微笑。他们放松的肢体语言展现了舒适、陪伴与永恒的浪漫。男子留着浓密蓬松的黑色波浪卷发，质感自然，留有浅浅的胡茬，身穿 宽松的白色亚麻衬衫，袖口随意卷起，搭配米色休闲长裤。女子长发整齐后梳，佩戴优雅的银色 Jhumka 耳环，妆容清透自然，额间点缀着一颗小巧的黑色眉心坠，身着飘逸的白色刺绣传统服饰，带有精致的花卉纹理和蕾丝细节。背景展示了在柔和的金色夕阳照耀下，富有戏剧性的季风云层。柔和的阳光穿透云层，营造出电影级的体积光效果。海浪猛烈地拍打着黑色的礁石，激起闪烁的水花和海雾。地平线散发着温暖的橙金色调，天空则过渡到冷灰蓝色的风暴云，形成鲜明对比。采用写实的双重曝光融合技术，使上方的肖像自然过渡到下方的海滩景观，边缘柔和。保留面部比例、真实的皮肤纹理、细致的睫毛、细微的胡须、刺绣织物细节以及每一根发丝。色调应结合温暖的金色夕阳高光与冷蓝灰色的海岸色调，营造出梦幻而自然的电影氛围。增加人物周围柔和的轮廓光、浅景深、湿润岩石上的真实倒影、淡淡的海雾以及清晰的环境细节。氛围应宁静、亲密、怀旧且情感丰富，如同高端浪漫电影海报。摄影风格：超写实、电影感、编辑风格、艺术肖像、HDR、自然肤色、柔和黄金时刻光影、体积光、浅景深、85mm 镜头、f/1.8、高动态范围、8K、极致细节、照片级真实感、高级调色、获奖浪漫摄影作品、大师级品质。负面提示词：低分辨率、模糊、过度锐化、噪点图像、卡通、动漫、绘画、CGI、人造皮肤、塑料质感
